subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects and recovery cannot establish its terminal outcome, should `openclaw agent` automatically use the existing isolated embedded fallback, fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerun, or retain the current immediate fallback behavior?
rationale: This is a documented CLI compatibility contract governing latency, whether the user receives any result, and whether duplicate model/tool/delivery effects may occur; code review cannot safely choose that product trade-off.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the original run first, then preserve the current fresh-session embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted.

options.title: Require explicit rerun after ambiguity
options.body: Fail closed after an unresolved outcome and expose rerun only through an approved explicit CLI option with matching help and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Retain immediate fallback
options.body: Keep current main behavior and close or substantially narrow this PR if recovery-first is not the desired CLI interaction.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the original run first, then preserve the current fresh-session embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session fallback containment behavior and are the clearest history-backed owner for the successor disconnect contract.
